verdict.rationale: Mirroring repositories or branches to and from another Git server is a fair question for a Git hosting product, but the evidence pack never documents a mirroring capability. The only nearby evidence is a one-off migration app from Bitbucket Server/Data Center to Cloud and community mentions of importing repos. Both are single transfers, not continuous or recurring two-way mirroring, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can mirror repositories or branches to and from another Git server
